controls.label: Shape
controls.description: The shared grid marks unavailable surface imagery on this radar model. The narrow neck and two lobes are constrained by radar and lightcurves, while weakly observed regions and facet-scale detail remain model-dependent. The published pole is uncertain by 5 degrees and the equivalent diameter by 8%. No resolved optical surface map is supplied. Lighting uses the published pole and arbitrary display phase.
controls.title: Radar shape model

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: False color shows radius at the nearest source-surface point minus a 1.01 km reference sphere. It includes global shape, not gravitational height or independent measured topography. Correspondence farther than 26 m is withheld. The narrow neck and two lobes are constrained by radar and lightcurves, while weakly observed regions and facet-scale detail remain model-dependent. The published pole is uncertain by 5 degrees and the equivalent diameter by 8%. No resolved optical surface map is supplied.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
